Our Story

It started with one roaster and a stubborn idea

In 2019, EMBER began as a single 5kg roaster in a Banani side-street, with one stubborn idea: Dhaka deserves coffee that is roasted here, rested properly, and brewed with patience — not shipped stale from halfway across the world.

Today we work directly with growers in Ethiopia, Colombia, Sumatra and Brazil, roast in small batches twice a week, and run a slow bar where every pour-over is made to order. No syrups hiding bad beans. No shortcuts. Just heat, time and attention.

Sourced with names, not numbers

We know the farms and the people behind every lot we buy.

Roasted 48 hours before it meets water

Every batch rests exactly two days — never served tired, never served raw.

A room built for slow mornings

Warm wood, low light, no rush. Stay for one cup or the whole afternoon.

From Cherry to Cup

Four steps, zero shortcuts

Every lot that reaches your cup passes through the same four hands-on stages.

01

Select

We cup dozens of samples each season and buy only the lots that stop the table talking.

02

Roast

Small 12kg batches, profiled per origin, roasted every Tuesday and Friday in-house.

03

Rest

Beans rest 48 hours so gases settle and sweetness opens up before the first grind.

04

Brew

Weighed, timed and poured by hand — 1:16 ratio, water at exactly 93°C.

Good Questions

Before you visit

The things guests ask us most — answered straight.

Do I need to book, or can I just walk in?

Walk-ins are always welcome. On Friday and Sunday mornings the slow bar fills up fast, so booking a table on WhatsApp takes two minutes and guarantees your seat.

Can I buy beans for home? Will you grind them?

Yes — every origin on the shelf is sold in 250g bags, whole bean or ground for espresso, filter, French press or moka pot. Tell us your brewer and we grind to match, free.

Do you have non-dairy milk and decaf?

Oat, soy and almond milk are available on any drink for +৳60. Our Swiss-water decaf is a proper coffee, not a punishment — try it as a flat white.

Is there Wi-Fi and space to work?

Fast Wi-Fi, plenty of plugs and a quiet corner kept laptop-friendly on weekdays. On weekend mornings we gently keep it conversation-first.

Do you deliver beans outside Dhaka?

Beans Club subscriptions ship anywhere in Bangladesh within 2–3 working days. Single bags can be ordered on WhatsApp — delivery charge depends on your district.

Can I book the space for a small event?

The back room seats 14 and hosts tastings, book clubs and small celebrations. Message us on WhatsApp with your date and group size, and we will plan the coffee around it.
